name: @light-right/design-system
description: relay Design System — Tailwind CSS v4 based design tokens & HTML snippet library

scripts.dev: npm run build:icons && npm run build:mcp-index && npm run build:pages && vite
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build:mcp-index && esbuild src/mcp/server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=bundle --outfile=dist/mcp.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && chmod +x dist/mcp.mjs
scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.tokens.config.ts && npm run build:icons && npm run build:mcp
scripts.build:site: npm run build:icons && npm run build:mcp-index && vite build && npm run build:pages && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && cp examples/icons.svg site/icons.svg && cp -R examples/assets/. site/assets/ && mkdir -p site/eval-outputs && cp -R examples/eval-outputs/. site/eval-outputs/
